name: oxt-beyond
description: Read and build the xTalk stacks open in OXT-Beyond: cards, controls, scripts and new stacks, with code checked and run on its engine.
long_description: The xTalk MCP Bridge of OXT-Beyond, a free IDE for xTalk Script (the language of LiveCode Community and OpenXTalk). With the bridge turned on in OXT-Beyond (Development > Plugins > xTalk MCP Bridge), Claude can list and read the stacks open there, look at their cards, look up the Dictionary, compile code, build controls, cards, scripts and new stacks as checked batches that can be undone, run code in a sandbox or on a stack, and save. It talks only to OXT-Beyond on this computer.

tools.name: xtalk_guide
tools.description: The guide to writing xTalk Script for OXT-Beyond

tools.name: list_stacks
tools.description: The user's stacks open in OXT-Beyond

tools.name: ide_context
tools.description: The selection, the script open in the Script Editor and the last error

tools.name: read_stack
tools.description: An outline of a stack, or cards and controls with their properties and scripts

tools.name: read_script
tools.description: A script, whole and in parts, with line numbers and its handlers

tools.name: search_scripts

tools.name: look_at_card
